metadata.title: Tech stocks are dragging indexes lower, while most of the market is doing fine - MarketWatch

content.text:
27 min ago
Tech stocks are dragging indexes lower, while most of the market is doing fine
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite had given up their gains in early trading, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average traded comfortably in positive territory. This disconnect was mostly due to one sector: tech.
The S&P 500 Information Technology Sector Index was down 1.2%, underperforming the other 11 sectors today. Both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq are skewed by large-cap tech companies, and many of them were trading lower for the day. For example, Nvidia was down 1.7% and Microsoft was down 1.6%.
Meanwhile, other sectors were doing just fine today, suggesting a bit of a rotation away from tech and into more defensive sectors. The S&P 500 Utilities Sector Index was up 1.3%, the S&P 500 Industrials Sector Index was up 1.1% and the S&P 500 Consumer Staples Sector Index was up 0.9%.
